description.en:
Sets the character the camera keeps looking at: the look-at point becomes the character's position, raised by _ofsy. Passing 0 as the character clears it (CamCtrlInit does this).
The setting is stored in the camera-control state. A later CamCtrlMoveTo takes it with its move, and sysCamCtrlStep then aims the camera at the character during that move. When no move is queued, sysCamCtrlStep still sets the camera's look-at point on the character every frame.
The camera handle argument is not used.
No shipped event calls it directly.
The camera-control helpers keep their state in subev_ctx.cam_ctrl, the context of an event started by CallEvent. While such an event runs, CallEvent calls sysCamCtrlStep every frame: it applies the engine's camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA) to the camera, keeps the look-at point on the followed character when there is one, and marks the move as finished once it is over (see IsCamCtrlMove).
Camera handle (not used by the function).
Character to look at, or 0 for none.
Height added to the character's position for the look-at point.

examples.case: Keeping a character in view during a move (not found in script_clean/; invented)
